title: Tournament C: 8 computation-model mechanisms closed; only RS list decoding at d>=2 left formally open
question: Idea tournament C (ECDLP-66, unconventional computation models and representations): 8 mechanisms, none survives. C5 multiplicative-character leak in (Z/r)* (Pohlig-Hellman on the exponent unit group, self-reduced by known multipliers): algebraic form hits Theorem B / missing DH oracle; statistical form bounded by the leakage bar (eps* ~0.0026 at 2^64 for smooth r-1, unreviewed cost model); test on 6 curves at 16/18/20 bits null (smallest p 9.4e-4 vs Bonferroni 1.4e-5, 99% upper bound on held-out gain <= 0.0055 at 2^20), planted 0.05 leak detected on all 6. C6 Reed-Solomon (Guruswami-Sudan) list decoding of the dlog codeword: partial-agreement bound leaves window sqrt(Nd) < t <= 2 sqrt(Nd); null at d=1 on 12 cells, planted control detected; d>=2 and the decoder not implemented (open). C2 Pollard-Strassen / P-recursive product: index-group mismatch (Z/r vs Z/p), no recurrence with d,e <= 6 on 4 curves (controls found). C1 Hankel/Berlekamp-Massey: linear complexity = r on 9/9 curves (planted order r/4 recovered). C4 dequantised Shor / tensor network: flat full-rank singular spectra, bond dimension >= r/2 (r=137, 1013). C3 rank-3 Cauchy-like Cayley table: whole-group objects cost >= r. C7 polynomial/product-tree BSGS: S T^2 ~ r and Theorem DT (paper). C8 greedy Cayley navigation: needs a k-predicting embedding = round-20 leakage bar (paper). Same-implementation rho control 1.095 sqrt(r)+166 (95% CI on coefficient [0.76,1.49]).
rationale: User directive 2026-11-03: original research, not re-testing literature.
